source_prompts.gatot: Use case: scientific-educational. Asset type: transparent 2D articulated puppet sprite sheet for an Indonesian cultural web application. Create an exquisite hand-painted leather shadow puppet inspired by East Javanese Jekdong Gathutkaca Krodha, explicitly an interpretative illustration, NOT a 3D toy or human. Landscape canvas with a completely transparent background. Full flat side profile facing RIGHT. Traditional broad muscular torso, fierce rounded reddish-brown face with one large eye, broad blunt nose, pronounced black moustache, visible small white teeth; black swept curly hair and sculpted gold ear ornaments; ornate red black and gold textiles with tiny tumpal triangles; white patterned knee-length trousers, bent legs and broad feet with angular dark tips; antique gold punched leather filigree, red and emerald accents, fine black ink outlines. Important sprite sheet layout: LEFT HALF contains ONLY the COMPLETE ARMLESS BODY (head, torso, costume, legs and central slim dark support rod), large and centered with generous margin. RIGHT HALF contains FOUR DETACHED arm pieces, spaced very far apart in a clean 2x2 layout, all matching the body scale and colors: upper-left upper arm A, upper-right upper arm B, lower-left forearm and scissor-like fingers A, lower-right forearm and scissor-like fingers B. Upper arms point straight down with round shoulder and elbow caps; forearms point straight down with a slight bend and attached complete hands. Body has small round gold shoulder sockets but absolutely NO attached arms. All components are isolated with fully transparent gaps; never touching each other. No labels, no letters, no title, no shadows, no frame, no decorative background, no duplicated body. Fine detailed polished museum-quality flat illustration with crisp readable silhouette and authentic leather texture.

No words, no typography, no labels, no background, no floor, no glow, no shadow. Not cartoon3D, not humanportrait, not fantasy elf. source_prompts.gunungan: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent decorative GUNUNGAN leather shadow-puppet illustration for opening a cultural web application. Create one tall symmetrical pointed leaf-shaped gunungan inspired by Javanese wayang kulit, refined antique hand-painted punched leather. At its heart a graceful tree-of-life, branches, birds, tiny forest animals and delicate scrolling vines arranged symmetrically, lower area a small stylized gateway and ornamental face motif. Dark ebony pierced cutout spaces with muted antique GOLD edging, ivory details, sparse brick-red and deep green enamel accents. A slim straight dark support rod extends down the center beneath the base. Flat front orthographic view, no perspective, no thickness, no 3D. High detail but clean strong silhouette suited to display on warm cream cloth. The single whole object fills a portrait canvas with generous transparent margin, pointed top and bottom support rod fully visible. GENUINELY TRANSPARENT background, including all pierced holes; no backdrop, no black rectangle, no checkerboard, no floor, no shadows, no glow, no writing, no watermark.
